name: 役割と個人メモを含むメンバー詳細
prompt: Faithfully recreate the full Japanese member-detail sheet in the primary native preview, using its exact 390x818 white canvas. Treat the native preview as the complete authority for all Japanese copy, colors, component positions, sizes, spacing and wrapping. Reproduce the forest-green header ending at y=138, overlapping mint avatar at x=18,y=103 about 86px diameter, name 「山田 はるか」 and muted subtitle 「やまだ・はるか ・ 呼称：彼女」, then the shared-group icon and 「共通のグループ 1件」. Preserve the four evenly spaced action buttons with pale mint circular icon backgrounds and exact labels 「メッセージ」「音声通話」「ビデオ通話」「友だち申請」. Below them, preserve the membership-date mint card with title 「メンバーになった日」 and entries 「登録・2022年7月14日」 and 「参加・2022年12月13日」, including the native wrap of the final 「日」 on the right. Preserve the 「役割」 card with its exact 3x3 white-pill grid and uniform green dots, labels in order: 「画面づくり」「企画担当」「学生」; 「地域の仲間」「海外の仲間」「呼称：彼女」; 「交流会」「確認済み」「個別連絡可」. At the bottom, preserve the private-note row 「メモ（自分だけに表示）」 and its forest-green plus icon. Keep the compact typography and the exact y positions/gaps from the native preview. There are no hyperlinks in this sheet: action labels, membership dates, role chips and the private-note action remain in native dark/gray/green colors; do not make text blue. The source screenshot is semantic context only. Do not copy English labels, photos, PXL badge, source menu, source colors or extra content. Render the full sheet only, with no frame or shadow.
reviewNotes: Profile/actions align well and all labels are exact. The first version placed the date card about 2px high and made it about 5px too tall; role card top about 3px high; note row about 4–5px high. No hyperlinks.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
